anomalies_and_flags.description: Massive non-recurring tax benefit credit of $1,244,429.84 recorded directly inside operating expenses for 2025-12. This credit causes total operating expenses to flip to negative (-$402,142.09) and yields an artificial operating profit of +$534,551.41.
anomalies_and_flags.impact: CRITICAL AUDIT FINDING: The business DID NOT become genuinely operationally profitable in Dec 2025. Underlying normalized core operating loss (excluding this tax credit, SBC, and non-operating interest) was -$381,241.27 (or -$375,217.90 if excluding only tax benefit and SBC, retaining non-operating interest in opex).
anomalies_and_flags.recommendation: Adjust out this non-recurring tax credit when evaluating operational cash burn or recurring financial performance.
